FOMC.label: Fed rate decision (2:00pm ET statement)
FOMC.read: direction is a coin flip at 4h/24h; size is not - moves ~1.4-1.7x normal. 72h after, BTC was lower 15 of 22 times (median -0.98%), thin sample.

CPI.label: CPI inflation report (8:30am ET)
CPI.read: BTC tended to drift UP into the print (63% of the 4h before) and dip right after (44% up in the 4h after). Moves ~1.3-2x normal around the release.

NFP.label: Jobs report / NFP (8:30am ET)
NFP.read: run-up-then-fade: up 73% of the 4h before, then up only 46% over the next 24h.

OPEX.label: Monthly options expiry (last Friday, Deribit 08:00 UTC)
OPEX.read: strongest calendar lean found: expiry day closed UP only 36% of the time (12/33), mean -0.41%.
